name: Sunken Stories
source:
Beneath a sunlit surface that belies its chilling depths, the Bright Lake holds its sorrows close. They say a loneliness so profound resides there, it pulls others into its beautiful, treacherous embrace, dragging them down into an endless quiet. For decades, it has guarded the stories of those who walked its shores and never returned.

[From [url=https://driftingquill.itch.io/sunken-stories]Itch.io[/url]]
